svg.title: Partner Couplings, Divisibility Count, and 12-Copy Sharpness Ceiling in Stage 02
svg.desc: Publication-grade editorial mathematical diagram pairing the Stage 02 divisibility lower bound (Count.lean, NullFrames.lean) with the 12-copy sharpness ceiling (LeastValuation.lean, Cases.lean, BoundAttained.lean) in three horizontal bands. Band 1 depicts concrete paired Young diagrams kappa_tau and kappa_{tau'} linked by the asymmetric Frobenius coupling arrow Gamma_e: z_tau^{p^e} * z_{tau'} for partner place tau' = -p^e * tau in Phi_s (e in I_p^0, e <= floor(log_p B)). On kappa_tau, height-1 columns (a_tau boxes) are highlighted in cobalt, low columns of height 1 < h < N (a'_tau columns containing l_tau boxes) are highlighted in emerald, and height-N columns are hatched and excluded from B = sum_tau (a_tau + l_tau). On partner kappa_{tau'}, the corresponding a_{tau'}, a'_{tau'}, and l_{tau'} boxes are paired against kappa_tau, while a dashed amber callout explains marked places (marked : Finset Phi_s) whose height-1 columns are exempted from null-frame elimination via row charges p^{w(tau,h,b)}, producing the same deduction effect as eraseHeightOne kappa marked. Band 2 presents a proportional balance and subtraction bar comparing the Legendre-minus-varpi^B baseline gamma_p B = (1/(p-1) - rho_p) sum_tau (a_tau + l_tau) against the subtracted null-frame deduction v(pi_p) sum deductionTerm from matrices g_{tau,h} forcing Gamma_e(z(s)) = 0 (mod pi_p) for e <= floor(log_p B), plus the O(f N^3 log_p B) factorial error, isolating the Schur-jet lower bound v_p(schurJet) >= v_p(P_y(d)F(0)) >= predictedDivisibility_p(kappa) - f N^3 (1 + log_p max(B, 1)) with explicit formula v(pi_p) sum_{e in I_p} sum_tau ((a_tau/p^e - a_{tau'} - a'_{tau'})_+ + (l_tau/p^e - l_{tau'})_+ - a'_tau/p^e) and the ramified p = d (e = 0) half-term -1/2 sum_tau (min(a_tau, a_{tau'_0} + a'_{tau'_0}) + a'_tau + min(l_tau, l_{tau'_0})). Band 3 closes the valuation sandwich with the 6 + 6 = 12 copy sharpness ceiling in twelveSpace (Fin 12 x Unit): Lagrange four-squares delta = (1, a_0, a_1, a_2, a_3, 0) with sum delta_c^2 = 0 turns prod_{c=0}^5 Theta(delta_c z) into a power-series unit, freeing Copies 0-5 (val_6) to harvest near-pair couplings nu' + nu'' and Copies 6-11 (val_6) to attain the Katz limit on remainder eta = l - (nu' + nu''). The headline theorem exists_rpow_neg_localPrimeSumTotal_le_norm_coeff exhibits a single global nonzero scalar t with |sigma t| <= exp(f m b / k) for all sigma in Aut(C) attaining v_p <= S_p + v_p(t) (S_p = D.localPrimeSumTotal p) simultaneously at every prime p, feeding Stage 06 TwistedValueHeights.

g.text: 1 · PAIRED YOUNG DIAGRAMS κτ & κτ' (τ' = −peτ ∈ Φs)
Active boxes: B = ∑τ (aτ + lτ) · height-N columns excluded
NullFrames.lean: steer gτ,h to kill Γe(z(s)) ≡ 0 (mod πp) for e ≤ ⌊logp B⌋
2 · LEGENDRE BASELINE − NULL-FRAME DEDUCTION = DIVISIBILITY LOWER BOUND
γp B = (1/(p−1) − ρp) B = γp ∑τ (aτ + lτ)
vp(schurJet) ≥ vp(Py(∂)F(0)) ≥ predictedDivisibilityp(κ) − f N³ (1 + logp max(B, 1))
predictedDivisibilityp(κ, N) = v(πp) ∑e∈Ip ∑τ [ (aτ/pe − aτ' − a'τ')+ + (lτ/pe − lτ')+ − a'τ/pe ]
Ramified p = d (e = 0 half-term): − ½ ∑τ [ min(aτ, aτ'₀ + a'τ'₀) + a'τ + min(lτ, lτ'₀) ]
Valuation sandwich: Lower Bound (Count) ≤ vp ≤ Sp + vp(t) (Sharpness)
3 · MATCHING 12-COPY SHARPNESS CEILING (UPPER BOUND ON vp)
δ = (1, a₀, a₁, a₂, a₃, 0) ∈ ℤp6
Single global t ≠ 0 (∀ σ ∈ Aut ℂ):
